work.label: Selected Work
work.heading: Real products. Shipped, measured, owned.
work.intro: A few of the frontends I've led. Each one: the problem we started with, the approach I took, and what it actually meant for the people using it.

projects.name: GoPay
projects.blurb: A SADAD-integrated B2B billing and collections platform for Saudi Arabia — public site, operator dashboard and customer apps.
projects.problem: Businesses across regulated Saudi sectors needed one place to issue invoices, collect through every local channel, stay ZATCA-compliant, and see their cash flow — without stitching tools together.
projects.solution: The GoPay frontend, end to end: the marketing site plus the operator dashboard — one-time and recurring payments, invoicing (GoInvoice / ZATCA), reconciliations and approvals — wired to mada, Apple Pay, Visa, Mastercard and SADAD.
projects.impact: Trusted by leading Saudi organisations — including the Royal Commission for AlUla, the Gulf Health Council and Tawzea Aquapor.
projects.role: Senior Frontend Engineer / Frontend Lead — BitBang

projects.name: WalaPlus
projects.blurb: A loyalty and employee-rewards platform for Saudi enterprises — points, offers and cashback across a network of real retail brands.
projects.problem: Enterprises needed to run points, rewards, offers and cashback for thousands of employees and family accounts — across dozens of merchants — from one admin, in Arabic and English.
projects.solution: A bilingual (RTL / LTR) admin: customizable dashboards, points-pool management, reward catalogs, retailer and offer administration, employee invites by email or file, and reports on transactions, points and savings.
projects.impact: A platform tracking 2.8B+ loyalty points across 114 retailers — including LandMark, HungerStation and Careem.

images.caption: Points and rewards report
images.alt: WalaPlus admin — rewards and points dashboard

projects.name: Fatura
projects.blurb: A B2B wholesale-ordering and credit platform for FMCG distribution — including the operation that runs Coca-Cola’s distribution in Egypt.
projects.problem: Distributors, operations, auditors, collectors and retail clients each needed their own workflow over one shared catalog, order flow and credit ledger.
projects.solution: Role-specific portals on a shared React / TypeScript / Vue frontend: an orders & transactions console, a catalog and ad-campaign builder, and BelAgel — a credit-collections system with retailer wallets, settlements and collector routing. Backed by Node / Express endpoints.
projects.impact: One platform serving multiple distributor teams, with a live credit ledger tracking retailer settlements at scale.

projects.name: Møller Auto
projects.blurb: The used-car marketplace for Volkswagen and Audi’s official dealer network across the Baltics.
projects.problem: Hundreds of live cars across a multi-country dealer network — each with deep specs, pricing, leasing and reservation flows — all needing to load fast and stay legible.
projects.solution: A performant listing and detail experience: faceted search over 800+ cars, spec-dense car pages, a leasing calculator, trade-in, and a dealership locator spanning Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania.
projects.impact: 800+ live used-car listings served across the Baltic VW & Audi dealer network.

images.caption: Car detail — modal view
images.alt: Møller Auto — Car detail — modal view

projects.name: Printerbase
projects.blurb: One of the UK’s established printer, ink & toner retailers — 200,000+ customers, rated 4.8/5 on Trustpilot.
projects.problem: A large-catalog retailer needed conversion-focused storefront and content pages that stayed consistent across a sprawling site.
projects.solution: Storefront and content surfaces built to convert — product discovery and comparison, subscription-print and managed-print journeys, and the checkout basket — all aligned to the brand system.
projects.impact: Part of a storefront serving 200,000+ customers, rated 4.8/5 on Trustpilot and 4.9/5 on Google.

projects.name: 21 Farmer
projects.blurb: A real-time dashboard that turns field IoT sensors into decisions for farmers.
projects.problem: Raw sensor streams — soil moisture, salinity, EC/TDS, air temperature, humidity and lux — mean nothing to a farmer without a clear, map-based view of each field.
projects.solution: A map-first dashboard: draw fields on satellite maps, bind them to sensor gateways, and read multi-metric time-series per field across day / week / month / year, with recommendations.
projects.impact: A data-heavy interface that makes eight live sensor metrics legible per field, at a glance.

images.caption: Drawing a field on the satellite map
images.alt: 21 Farmer — Drawing a field on the satellite map

about.label: About
about.heading: A senior engineer who cares about the parts users ==don't== see.
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack engineer with a frontend heart, drawn to the unglamorous half of the job — the architecture, the tokens, the component contracts, the performance budgets. The work that decides whether a product feels solid six months after launch, or starts to rot.

For **six-plus years** I've shipped fintech dashboards, admin portals, and design-system-driven apps. I translate ambiguous designs into clean interfaces, raise the floor through reviews and standards, and use *AI tooling daily* as a multiplier — while owning every decision that ships.

experience.label: Experience
experience.heading: Six years, across fintech, platforms & operations.

roles.description: Owns the GoPay frontend — a SADAD-integrated B2B billing platform — leads and mentors engineers, and sets the standards that keep delivery fast and maintainable.
Built the WalaPlus loyalty & rewards admin — bilingual dashboards, points pools, reward catalogs and reporting — for enterprise employee-loyalty programs across Saudi retail brands.

Built ordering, operations, audit and collector portals — plus the BelAgel credit-collections system — on a shared React, TypeScript and Vue frontend, with Node/Express endpoints. The platform also powered Coca-Cola’s distribution operations in Egypt.
Frontend delivery on large-scale e-commerce alongside a distributed team — the Møller Auto marketplace (VW & Audi) and the Printerbase storefront.
Built the Andalusia Care site in Nuxt to improve patient access to healthcare services and information.
Started in mobile with Flutter — a reservation app that passed 1,000+ downloads, and a foundation in cross-platform UI that still informs how I design for multiple surfaces.

principles.label: How I think
principles.heading: A frontend that ==lasts==.
principles.intro: Everything below is in service of one idea: code that the next engineer — or future me — can pick up and move forward without flinching.

items.title: Component architecture
items.description: Composable components with clear boundaries and predictable APIs. The shape of the code should make the wrong thing awkward to write.

items.title: Reusable patterns
items.description: Extract once, reuse everywhere. One source of truth beats five near-copies that drift apart over a year.

items.title: Design systems & tokens
items.description: Tokens, themes, and docs that keep the UI consistent and themable — so change is a variable, not a refactor.

items.title: Reviews & standards
items.description: Reviews that raise the floor, not the ego. Readable, tested, maintainable code as the default.

items.title: Performance
items.description: Real budgets and measured metrics. Rendering that stays smooth under the load that actually ships.

items.title: Developer experience
items.description: Tooling and docs that make the whole team faster. DX is a feature the users never see but always feel.

items.title: Detail at the smallest scale
